blessing-of-the-inner-fire.Effect:
The Invoker blesses up to three targets with the following effect

DoS 4+: The subjects add one additional DoS to all tests they do for the duration.

DoS 1-3: If the subjects roll at least 1 DoS they add one additional DoS to the test for the duration.

DoF 4+: The subjects add one additional DoF to all tests they do for the duration.

SetBaseCharacteristics.RollSectionNote: Fields are editable and typed values are used on submit. Roll assignment mode controls how the 7 rolled values map to STR/END/AGI/INT/WP/PRC/PRS.

Opposed.WaitingBothCommit: Waiting for both sides to commit choices...
Opposed.WaitingDefendersCommit: Waiting for all defenders to commit choices.

Startup.ThanksDogBoneZone: DogBoneZone, the original author of the `uesrpg-d100` Foundry VTT system from which this fork began.
Startup.ThanksGman95: Gman95, the original creator of the UESRPG-Revised module, from which much of this system's content was adapted.
Startup.ThanksMaintainers: jamejtb and supagreybard for maintaining and updating the main fork.
Startup.DisablePopupNote: You can disable this popup in System Settings by checking the option not to show it again.

noStartUpDialog.Name: Do Not Show Dialog on Startup
noStartUpDialog.Hint: Checking this box hides the startup popup dialog informing the user on additional game resources.

customCursor.Name: Custom Cursor
customCursor.Hint: Use the UESRPG stylized cursor (requires reload).

enableInlineRulesTooltips.Name: Sheets: Inline Rules Tooltips
enableInlineRulesTooltips.Hint: Show inline tooltips for qualities/traits and special actions. Alt-click opens a help dialog.

encumbranceUiEnhanced.Name: Sheets: Encumbrance Breakdown + Highlights
encumbranceUiEnhanced.Hint: Show ENC breakdown dialog and highlight top encumbrance contributors.

dialogKeyboardEnhancements.Name: Dialogs: Enhanced Keyboard Flow
dialogKeyboardEnhancements.Hint: When enabled, DialogV2 dialogs auto-focus the first input and support Enter/Esc keyboard actions in a consistent way.

enableItemRowQuickMenu.Name: Sheets: Item Row Quick Actions Menu
enableItemRowQuickMenu.Hint: When enabled, right-click on an item row opens a quick actions menu.

sheetDensity.Name: Sheets: Density
sheetDensity.Hint: Controls vertical spacing and row height for UESRPG AppV2 sheets.

useActorSheetV2.Name: Actor Sheet V2 Compatibility Flag
useActorSheetV2.Hint: Internal compatibility flag retained for migrated worlds. Actor sheets now use the AppV2 production path.

useItemSheetV2.Name: Item Sheet V2 Compatibility Flag
useItemSheetV2.Hint: Internal compatibility flag retained for migrated worlds. Item sheets now use the AppV2 production path.

sheetPerfTrace.Name: Sheet Performance Trace
sheetPerfTrace.Hint: Log AppV2 sheet timing traces for _prepareContext, _onRender, _attachPartListeners, and _onClose.

opposedShowResolutionDetails.Name: Opposed: Show Resolution Details
opposedShowResolutionDetails.Hint: When enabled, opposed-roll chat cards include an additional expandable section with detailed resolution data. Recommended for testing; disable for normal play.

opposedShowStatusLine.Name: Opposed: Show Status Line
opposedShowStatusLine.Hint: When enabled, opposed-roll chat cards include Status lines (Committed/Rolled/Resolved). Intended for debugging/testing.

enableLoadouts.Name: Sheets: Enable Equipment Loadouts
enableLoadouts.Hint: When enabled, the Items tab shows a per-user Loadout bar (save/apply equipped-state snapshots).

sheetDiagnostics.Name: Debug: Sheet Diagnostics Panel
sheetDiagnostics.Hint: When enabled, actor sheets show a small diagnostics panel (client only).

enableRuleElementsRuntime.Name: Rule Elements Runtime (Experimental)
enableRuleElementsRuntime.Hint: Enable runtime evaluation of Rule Elements (experimental).

dndDebugEnabled.Name: DnD Debug Logging
dndDebugEnabled.Hint: Log detailed drag-and-drop payload parsing and resolution diagnostics for sheet item transfers.

dndDebugVerbose.Name: DnD Debug Verbose Groups
dndDebugVerbose.Hint: Use grouped console output for drag-and-drop diagnostics (requires DnD Debug Logging).

dndDebugNotifyOnFailure.Name: DnD Debug Failure Notifications
dndDebugNotifyOnFailure.Hint: Show user warnings for terminal drag-and-drop failures with correlation IDs.

dndDebugDomEvents.Name: DnD Debug DOM Events
dndDebugDomEvents.Hint: Log low-level DOM dragstart/drop observer events (high volume).

dndDebugKeepRecentCount.Name: DnD Debug Recent Trace Count
dndDebugKeepRecentCount.Hint: How many recent in-memory DnD trace events to keep for dumpDndTrace helpers.

dndDebugCacheFallbackEnabled.Name: DnD Cache Fallback Enabled
dndDebugCacheFallbackEnabled.Hint: Allow last-drag payload cache fallback when drop payload parsing is incomplete.

aeLifecycleDebug.Name: Active Effect Lifecycle Debug
aeLifecycleDebug.Hint: Log all AE fetch/delete operations (for troubleshooting only). Helps diagnose 'does not exist' errors.

perfDebug.Name: Performance Profiling
perfDebug.Hint: Log console.time/timeEnd markers for getData() and opposed resolution.

templateDebug.Name: Template Optimization Debug
templateDebug.Hint: Log template compilation caching and rendering performance diagnostics.

timePerformanceDebug.Name: Time/Combat: Round-Boundary Performance Recording
timePerformanceDebug.Hint: Record structured timing events for round-boundary phases: TimeService fan-out, spell tick dispatch, OverTime collect/process, turn-ticker sub-phases, and authority-proxy write counts. Access results via game.uesrpg.perf. Independent of the debug master gate.

spellTickDebug.Name: Spell Tick Engine: Debug Logging
spellTickDebug.Hint: When enabled, the spell tick engine logs turn/round/worldTime tick events and handler invocations.

overTimeDebug.Name: OverTime Effects: Debug Logging
overTimeDebug.Hint: When enabled, the OverTime effects engine logs effect collection, cadence gating, payload execution, and state updates.

compositeBoundaryTickEnabled.Name: Spell Tick: Composite Round-Boundary Dispatch
compositeBoundaryTickEnabled.Hint: When enabled, the spell tick engine collapses the four sequential round-boundary dispatches (turnStart, turnEnd, roundStart, roundEnd) into a single composite pass. Handlers that register fnBoundary receive one call with the full boundary context instead of four separate calls. The OverTime engine uses this to call _ensureIndex() once per boundary instead of four times. Default: true.

aggregateRegenPrompts.Name: Round Start: Aggregate Regeneration Prompts
aggregateRegenPrompts.Hint: When enabled, all regeneration prompts for a round are batched into one chat message instead of one message per actor. Default: false.

aggregateSilencedChecks.Name: Round Start: Parallelise Silenced Realization Checks
aggregateSilencedChecks.Hint: When enabled, silenced realization checks for all affected combatants run concurrently instead of sequentially. Messages are unchanged. Default: false.

useRoundStartCandidateRegistry.Name: Round Start: Candidate Registry
useRoundStartCandidateRegistry.Hint: When enabled, round-start Regeneration and Silenced candidate discovery uses an indexed registry instead of broad combatant scans each round boundary. Default: true.

skipAttackTrackerEagerReset.Name: Round Start: Skip Eager Attack Tracker Reset
skipAttackTrackerEagerReset.Hint: When enabled, the attack tracker skips per-actor document writes at round start. Attack counts reset lazily on first read/use in the new round. Default: false.

useZoneRegistry.Name: Timed Magic: Zone Registry
useZoneRegistry.Hint: When enabled, active spell zones are tracked in an indexed registry instead of scanning all actors on every turnEnd tick. Default: false.

useRuneRegistry.Name: Timed Magic: Rune Registry
useRuneRegistry.Hint: When enabled, active rune Origin AEs are tracked in an indexed registry instead of scanning all actors on every turnEnd, worldTime tick, and token move. Default: false.

useCloakRegistry.Name: Timed Magic: Cloak Actor Registry
useCloakRegistry.Hint: When enabled, actors with active Origin AEs are tracked in a Set so the cloak tick handler can skip actors that are not known cloak casters without calling getOriginAEs(). Default: false.

deferNonCriticalRoundBoundaryWork.Name: Round Boundary: Defer Non-Critical Presentation Work
deferNonCriticalRoundBoundaryWork.Hint: When enabled, non-rules-critical round-boundary work is deferred until after the combat tracker UI has visibly updated. Rules-critical phases remain synchronous. Default: false.

useCombatBoundaryOrchestrator.Name: Round Boundary: Use Internal Orchestrator (Optional)
useCombatBoundaryOrchestrator.Hint: When enabled, selected internal post-boundary consumers run through one ordered orchestrator lane instead of separate direct uesrpg.combatTimeChanged listeners. Default: true.

debugEnabled.Name: Enable World Debug Logging
debugEnabled.Hint: Enables all UESRPG world-level debug logging. Covers opposed workflows, spell casting, talents, wounds, and more.

debugClientEnabled.Name: Enable Client Debug Logging
debugClientEnabled.Hint: Enables all UESRPG client-level debug logging for this user. Covers AE lifecycle, aim, sheet diagnostics, performance traces, and more.

showFeatureInspector.Name: Show Feature Inspector
showFeatureInspector.Hint: When enabled, shows the Feature Inspector provenance panel on PC and NPC actor sheets. Debug tool hidden by default.

opposedDebug.Name: Opposed Debug Logging
opposedDebug.Hint: When enabled, the opposed-roll workflow logs detailed diagnostic information to the browser console.

effectsProxyDebug.Name: Effects/Proxy Debug Logging
effectsProxyDebug.Hint: When enabled, the authority proxy logs concise diagnostics to the browser console.

debugMagicRouting.Name: Magic: Routing Debug Logging
debugMagicRouting.Hint: When enabled, spell routing decisions are logged to the browser console. Recommended only for testing.

opposedDebugFormula.Name: Opposed Debug: Formula Normalization
opposedDebugFormula.Hint: When enabled, logs when a roll formula is normalized or rejected before evaluation.

spellCastingDebug.Name: Spell Casting: Workflow Debug Logging
spellCastingDebug.Hint: When enabled, spell casting workflow logs comprehensive diagnostic information including spell data, dialog construction, and scaling level processing.

activationDebug.Name: Activation/Talent: Debug Logging
activationDebug.Hint: When enabled, activation and talent automation workflows log detailed diagnostics to the browser console.

skillRollDebug.Name: Skill Roll Debug Logging
skillRollDebug.Hint: When enabled, skill rolls and skill-opposed workflows log structured diagnostic information to the browser console.

debugSkillTN.Name: Debug: Skill TN Macro
debugSkillTN.Hint: When enabled, exposes game.uesrpg.debugSkillTN(...) for diagnosing skill TN computation.

debugAim.Name: Aim: Debug Audit Logging
debugAim.Hint: When enabled, logs Aim apply/stack, break, and consume events to the browser console.

debugActorSelect.Name: Actor Select: Debug Logging
debugActorSelect.Hint: When enabled, logs TN-relevant actor context whenever you control a token.

woundsDebug.Name: Wounds: Debug Logging
woundsDebug.Hint: When enabled, wound automation logs structured diagnostic information to the browser console.

shieldDebug.Name: Shield: Visibility Debug Logging
shieldDebug.Hint: When enabled, logs shield lifecycle, updates, containment, and inventory visibility decisions to the browser console.

automationProfile.Name: Automation Profile
automationProfile.Hint: Controls high-level combat automation policy. Assisted is the default; Custom preserves the existing hidden/internal settings.

actionPointAutomation.Name: Action Point Automation
actionPointAutomation.Hint: Round-Based: AP is set to max at the start of each round. Turn-Based: Ap is set to max at the start of each turn, except the first round in which all combatants start with max AP. None: No automation.

enableActionEconomyUI.Name: Combat Sheet: Action Economy UI
enableActionEconomyUI.Hint: When enabled, Combat tab quick action buttons are disabled when the actor has 0 Action Points.

tokenRangeMeasurement.Name: Combat: Token Range Measurement Mode
tokenRangeMeasurement.Hint: How to measure distance between tokens. 'Center Point': Always measure center-to-center (legacy, treats all tokens as 1x1). 'Edge to Edge': Measure from nearest edges for tokens larger than 1x1 (D&D/PF2e standard).

aoeContainmentMode.Name: Combat: AoE Containment Mode
aoeContainmentMode.Hint: How to determine if a token is inside an Area of Effect template. 'True Radius': geometric multi-point sampling - any corner or edge midpoint inside the template counts. 'Grid-Aware': checks if the template overlaps any grid cell occupied by the token.

aoeOriginMeasurement.Name: Combat: AoE Range Origin
aoeOriginMeasurement.Hint: How to measure range from the caster to an AoE placement or spell target. 'Center': from token center. 'Nearest Edge': from the closest edge of the caster token on square/gridless scenes, with center fallback on hex grids. 'Match Token': use the Token Range Measurement setting.

dynamicInitiativeEnabled.Name: Dynamic Initiative
dynamicInitiativeEnabled.Hint: When enabled, initiative is rerolled at each new round and committed atomically with the round advance so timing effects resolve against the new order.

woundsMode.Name: Wounds: Rules Mode
woundsMode.Hint: Standard: wound when damage exceeds WT. Alternate: wound on critical-success damage or reducing target to 0 HP.

damageAftermathBundlingEnabled.Name: Damage: Aftermath Bundling
damageAftermathBundlingEnabled.Hint: Custom automation profile only. When enabled, selected non-critical post-damage aftermath operations in the canonical resolved damage path are staged and committed in one ordered final pass.

enableMightyCleave.Name: Talents: Enable Mighty Cleave automation
enableMightyCleave.Hint: When enabled, Mighty Cleave can create a follow-up attack button on opposed cards (requires the talent). Disabled by default to avoid changing table enforcement assumptions.

enableFollowUpStrike.Name: Talents: Enable Follow-up Strike automation
enableFollowUpStrike.Hint: When enabled, Follow-up Strike can create a free follow-up attack button on opposed cards (requires the talent). Disabled by default to avoid changing table enforcement assumptions.

gladiatorAutomationMode.Name: Talents: Gladiator automation mode
gladiatorAutomationMode.Hint: Controls Gladiator free-defense behavior (Disabled, Original/Make, Updated/Can).

talentLearningMode.Name: Talents: Learning Enforcement Mode
talentLearningMode.Hint: Off: no checks. Warn: allow but show RAW violations. Enforce: block invalid talent acquisition and auto-deduct XP on success.

talentNoGoverningCostRule.Name: Talents: No-Governing XP Rule
talentNoGoverningCostRule.Hint: How to price talents that have no governing characteristic.

talentLearningNoticeMode.Name: Talents: Learning Notification Mode
talentLearningNoticeMode.Hint: Controls GM/player notification verbosity for talent learning checks.

enforceCharGenMilestones.Name: Enforce Character Generation Milestones
enforceCharGenMilestones.Hint: When enabled, Imperial racial talent automation (Red Diamond / Imperial Luck) applies only if the actor has flags.uesrpg.charGen.completed = true.

enableCharGenSlashCommand.Name: Enable /char Slash Command
enableCharGenSlashCommand.Hint: When enabled, /char opens the Character Generation Wizard.

useRawChargenWizard.Name: Character Generation: Use RAW Wizard Button
useRawChargenWizard.Hint: When enabled, actor sheets show a Character Creation (RAW) button that runs the RAW chargen flow.

chargenMagicPurchaseMode.Name: Character Generation: Spell Purchase Mode
chargenMagicPurchaseMode.Hint: Controls allowed payment resources for spell learning in RAW chargen.

chargenSpellLearningLogCap.Name: Character Generation: Spell Learning Log Cap
chargenSpellLearningLogCap.Hint: 0 = unlimited. Otherwise, keep only the most recent N spell learning log entries.

passiveTransferItemTypes.Name: Passive Transfer Item Types
passiveTransferItemTypes.Hint: Comma-separated item types whose transfer Active Effects apply passively while the item is in an actor's inventory.

enableSpellRecipes.Name: Spell Recipes (Experimental)
enableSpellRecipes.Hint: When enabled, shows the Effect Recipes UI on spell sheets. This feature is experimental and may not fully integrate with ActiveEffect creation.

skillRollLastOptions.Name: Skill Roll: Remember Last Options
skillRollLastOptions.Hint: Stores the last-used skill roll options for this user only.

skillRollQuickShift.Name: Skill Roll: Shift Quick Roll
skillRollQuickShift.Hint: When enabled, holding Shift will bypass the roll options dialog and use remembered/default options.

enableCastEnchantmentRuntime.Name: Enchanting: Enable Cast Enchantment Runtime
enableCastEnchantmentRuntime.Hint: When enabled, cast enchantments can cast stored spells using Soul Energy from the enchanted item pool.

enableChargedStrikeVariant.Name: Enchanting: Charged Strike Variant
enableChargedStrikeVariant.Hint: When enabled, strike enchantments can use a charge pool (cost / 10 charges). Optional rule.

enableCursedConstant.Name: Enchanting: Cursed Constant Enchantments
enableCursedConstant.Hint: When enabled, constant enchantments can be marked Cursed (cannot be disabled; special failure cadence per RAW). Optional rule.

requireLab.Name: Alchemy: Require Alchemy Lab
requireLab.Hint: When enabled (RAW), the actor must have an Alchemy Lab item in their inventory to brew potions, poisons, or toxins.

enableGatheringHelper.Name: Alchemy: Enable Gathering Helper
enableGatheringHelper.Hint: When enabled, the Workshop includes a Gather Ingredients mode to roll for and record gathered alchemical ingredients.

armorCoverageOverlayMode.Name: Armor Coverage Overlay
armorCoverageOverlayMode.Hint: Shows compact armor coverage badges beside hovered or targeted tokens. Disabled by default.

armorCoverageOverlayTransparency.Name: Armor Coverage Transparency
armorCoverageOverlayTransparency.Hint: Transparency of armor coverage overlay badges (0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque).

speedFormulaSBAB.Name: Homebrew: Speed Formula (SB + AB)
speedFormulaSBAB.Hint: When enabled, base Speed is computed as SB + AB (instead of SB + 2xAB). Requires a reload to apply consistently.

enabled.Name: Homebrew: Reach & Length Overhaul (Harnmaster-inspired)
enabled.Hint: When enabled, weapons gain explicit Length (LNG) values and model-specific homebrew reach overrides. Unlocks Length Penalty automation and the In Close condition. Requires a reload to apply consistently.

reachModel.Name: Homebrew: Reach Model
reachModel.Hint: Classic: min/max reach values per weapon (Harnmaster-style). Simplified: max reach only (d20-style, no minimum reach gating).

attackerAdvantageOnly.Name: Homebrew: Length Advantage (Attacker Only)
attackerAdvantageOnly.Hint: When enabled, Length TN modifiers apply only to the attacker side. Defender-side Length bonuses and penalties are both suppressed.

enabled.Name: Homebrew: Engagement & Flanking
enabled.Hint: Automatically computes Flanked (X) from engagement pressure and defensive training. Melee attackers gain +5 TN per Flanked point.

onlyInCombat.Name: Homebrew: Engagement & Flanking (Only In Combat)
onlyInCombat.Hint: When enabled, Flanked (X) automation runs only while combat is started.

enabled.Name: Homebrew: Mass Combat System
enabled.Hint: Enables the Warfare Unit actor type and mass combat UI. When disabled, existing Warfare Unit actors remain openable but new ones cannot be created.

enabled.Name: Homebrew: Religion & Worship
enabled.Hint: Enables the Religion & Worship subsystem, including ritual domains, invocations, worship state, and religion-specific GM tools.

reachVisualizer.Name: Reach Visualizer Settings
reachVisualizer.Hint: Client-scoped settings backing the Reach Visualizer submenu.

worldDataVersion.Name: World Data Version
worldDataVersion.Hint: Records the system version that last initialized this world. Used by the compatibility gate.

migrationDebug.Name: Migration Debug Logging
migrationDebug.Hint: When enabled, migrations log additional diagnostics.

templateOptimization.Name: Template Optimization
templateOptimization.Hint: Enables template compilation caching and optimization for improved performance.
